title: LARP feast recipe
description: Canonical recipe format for this catalog. A superset of the fields in a Paprika 3 export so recipes round-trip losslessly, plus optional LARP/feast fields. One recipe per file under recipes/, named <slug>.json.

slug.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated identifier. Must match the file name (recipes/<slug>.json).

ingredients.description: One string per ingredient line, as written. Use plain-text fractions like '1/2 cup', not Unicode fraction characters, so Paprika's scaling works.

image.description: Path to a local photo, relative to the repo root, e.g. images/mujendra.jpg.

paprika_uid.description: Paprika's uid, kept so a re-export updates the same recipe in Paprika instead of duplicating it. Set automatically on import; omitted for recipes that never came from Paprika.

course.description: Feast course this dish belongs to, e.g. remove, subtlety, side, bread, sweet.

base_headcount.description: Number of diners the quantities as written feed. Used by the (future) feast planner for scaling.

period_notes.description: Free text on the historical / thematic basis of the dish.
